record.paper_title: A collection of open problems in celebration of Imre Leader’s 60th birthday
record.context_brief: Average antipodal color-change complexity in Q_n
record.original_question: Among all edge colorings of the hypercube Q_n, how large can the average, over all antipodal pairs v and v̄, of the minimum number of color changes needed on a path from v to v̄ be? Equivalently, determine the maximum possible value of (1/2^n) Σ_{v∈Q_n} m(v), where m(v) is the minimum number of color changes on a path from v to its antipode.

evidence.quote: Question 8.3. How large can be the minimum number of colour-changes on a path between a randomly chosen pair of antipodal vertices? In other words, determine the maximum (over all edge colourings of Qn) of the quantity: 1/2^n Σ_{v∈Qn} (the minimum number of colour changes on a v-to-v̄ path).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $Q_n$ denote the $n$-dimensional hypercube, the graph with vertex set $\{0,1\}^n$ in which two vertices are adjacent iff they differ in exactly one coordinate. For a vertex $v \in \{0,1\}^n$, let $\bar v$ denote its antipode (the vertex obtained by flipping every coordinate). Given an edge-coloring $c$ of $Q_n$ (with no restriction on the number of colors), and a path $P = e_1 e_2 \cdots e_\ell$ in $Q_n$, define the number of color changes on $P$ to be $|\{i : 1 \le i < \ell,\ c(e_i) \ne c(e_{i+1})\}|$. For each $v \in V(Q_n)$, let
\[ m_c(v) = \min\{\text{number of color changes on } P : P \text{ is a path from } v \text{ to } \bar v\}. \]
Determine
\[ f(n) \;=\; \max_{c}\ \frac{1}{2^n} \sum_{v \in V(Q_n)} m_c(v), \]
where the maximum ranges over all edge-colorings $c$ of $Q_n$. In particular, give the asymptotic behavior of $f(n)$ as $n \to \infty$.
artifact.status_search_result: The closely related worst-case problem (minimum over antipodal pairs of the number of color changes needed) is itself open, with the best asymptotic upper bound being roughly $3n/8 + o(n)$ due to Dvořák (2020), and verifications for small $n$ by Frankston–Scheinerman (2024). The averaged variant asked here does not appear to have been resolved in the literature; it is posed as an open problem in the Leader 60th-birthday collection and no published solution was found.

status_evidence.title: A note on Norine's antipodal-colouring conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Dvořák shows every 2-edge-coloring of Q_n has an antipodal pair joined by a path with at most 0.375n+o(n) color changes.
status_evidence.claim: Best known asymptotic bound on the worst-case antipodal color-change problem.

status_evidence.title: Edge-antipodal colorings of cubes — Open Problem Garden
status_evidence.snippet: The edge-antipodal coloring problem for hypercubes is listed as open.
status_evidence.claim: Related antipodal hypercube coloring problems remain open.
